description:
The SI Tech Debate Team was founded upon the return from the COVID -19 shut down by a group of students eager to get back to normal and to showcase their amazing research and oracy skills.  We as a team have achieved remarkable success over the past three years, securing the title of state champions in both the Urban Debate League (2 years running) and the American Debate League (after only one season in the league). These accomplishments reflect the hard work, dedication, and talent of our students, who have consistently demonstrated exceptional skills in public speaking, critical thinking, and argumentation.

Students Debate monthly in pairs using the Public forum style.  The topics are set forth each month by the National Speech and Debate Association.  Debate Team Meetings are Tuesdays until 4 PM and are mandatory for all debaters.  Debate Season runs from Tryouts in September through April.
We are a tight-knit community of SITHS students who enjoy world history and geography!

Where cursive meets creativity!
Our club is a place where individuals can come to practice handwriting through various engaging forms like Chinese calligraphy, standard calligraphy, cursive, Russian cursive, bullet journaling, and planning. Additionally, we go over certain subjects like ways to study and forming study guides, how to time manage, and overall how to unleash your creativity through aesthetically pleasing writing. At Handwriting Club, you can appreciate writing through expression, and practice skills like pen control, stroke consistency, and simply developing neat and stylish handwriting techniques.

description:
Hey Techies! Let me introduce you to the largest service-based club at our school, Key Club!

Staten Island Tech Key Club has had a long tradition of dedicated community service and charitable fundraising. With over 200 official members, we have monthly meetings in the library, where our student led committees and officers focus on working with our greater organization Key Club International to build leadership, character building, caring and inclusiveness.

Whether it be through our weekly/bi-weekly service events, or our massive fundraisers, we seek to bring joy and purpose to both our community and our students. Some example of our large events include our annual Luna Park Fundraisers with schools across NYC, our annual Dave and Buster's Arcade Fundraiser, our annual Brooklyn Chinatown Lunar New Year  Parade and more!

If your interested in pursuing leadership and gaining volunteer hours, make sure to signup now for a chance to grow into a true leader of the community.
